# The Kenyan Wallstreet

> Kenya's premier platform for business intelligence, capital markets analysis, investment education, and workplace rankings.

The Kenyan Wallstreet delivers news, data, and AI-powered tools covering Kenya's financial markets, banking sector, and corporate landscape. The platform combines journalism with investment education through podcasts, conferences, and proprietary research on African finance.

## Key Topics

- Capital Markets
- Kenya Finance
- Investment Education
- Trading Psychology
- Stock Market
- Wealth Building
- AI Technology
- Banking Sector
- Career Finance
- Best Places to Work
- Employer Awards
- Kenyan Business
- Podcast Series
- Just Money Podcast
- Bullish Africa Conference

## Core Platforms & Events

- [The Kenyan Wall Street - Shows](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/shows): Podcast series featuring investment education, trading psychology and AI tools
- [Events Calendar](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/events): Calendar of business conferences including Bullish Africa 2026 and Kenya finance events
- [TKWS Best Places to Work Kenya](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/tkws-best-places-to-work-2026): TKWS Best Places to Work awards ranking Kenya's top employers

## Banking & Capital Markets

- [Co-op Posts Record 29.75 Bn Profit as Funding Costs Decline](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/coop-bank-profit-ksh29-75bn-dividend): Co-operative Bank posts record KSh 29.75B profit with 16.9% growth
- [Zenith Bank Targets London Listing to Drive Global Expansion](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/zenith-bank-targets-london-listing): Zenith Bank pursues London Stock Exchange listing for global expansion
- [I&M Bank and Sida's USD 30 Million Partnership](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/i-and-m-bank-and-sidas-usd-30-million-partnership): I&M Bank and Sida partnership for USD 30M green lending expansion in Kenya
- [Bank of Tanzania Joins Africa Finance Corporation](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/bank-of-tanzania-joins-africa-finance-corporation-as-equity-shareholder): Bank of Tanzania becomes sovereign shareholder in Africa Finance Corporation

## Investment & Economic Policy

- [$75 Trillion Access, $2 Billion A Day Target at KIICO 2026](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/partnerships/75-trillion-access-2-billion-a-day-target-at-kiico-2026): Kenya International Investment Conference 2026 targets $75T market access
- [State Struggles to Deploy Billions Through Digital Procurement](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/kenya-struggles-budget-through-egps): Kenya's E-GPS digital procurement delays slow budget execution and spending
- [Counties' Health Facility Cash Lifeline Raises Red Flags](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/counties-health-facility-cash-red-flags-fiscal-planning): Kenya county health facility financing raises fiscal planning concerns

## Consumer Protection & Regulation

- [When Product Safety Fails Consumers, Markets Fail- CAK Director General](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/when-product-safety-fails-consumers-markets-fail-cak-director-general): CAK Director General David K Kemei on product safety and consumer protection regulation
- [Recovery Gap Widens as Kenyans Take Months to Rebuild After Shocks](https://kenyanwallstreet.com/recovery-gap-widens-as-kenyans-take-months-to-rebuild-after-shocks): Tala report shows Kenyans face widening recovery gaps after financial shocks

## Regional Developments
